svg.title: CANOE transportation system
svg.desc: Transport inputs and infrastructure connect road, air, rail and marine technologies to distinct passenger and freight demands. Other off-road diesel use is counted directly. Purchased fuels enter at exogenous prices, while the CANOE electricity sector generates grid power endogenously in a coupled solve. Explicit charging shows light-duty public Level 2, public fast and private chargers, and medium- and heavy-duty overnight and fast chargers. A separate aggregated light-duty charging option can apply an hourly load profile to shared chargers, including pathways to motorcycle battery-electric, light-duty battery-electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles. Compressed gaseous hydrogen at 700 bar feeds light-duty and medium- and heavy-duty refueling stations. A parameter panel summarizes fleet, infrastructure and demand inputs. The powertrain key describes eligible technologies and optional light-duty plug-in ranges. S-JTF denotes conventional jet fuel blended with 50% HEFA synthetic paraffinic kerosene.
